name: Cluster Heart AP OLD

stealth.note: (master) to hear or feel the energy coalescing

description: A wave of magic passes through the area, causing crystal shards to grow and stab intruders.
disable: DC 45 Nature (master) to chip away at the crystal and disrupt its resonance, or DC 42 Thievery (master) to carefully detach the crystals and then safely smash them
reset: Once the cluster heart uses its reaction, it automatically resets after 1 minute. As long as the cluster heart has 150 or more Hit Points, it recovers 50 per day.

generalAbilities.name: Resistance to Disintegrate
generalAbilities.description: Disintegrate deals double damage, ignoring Hardness, rather than destroying the cluster heart outright

generalAbilities.name: Crystal Surge
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A non-elemental creature ends its turn adjacent to the cluster heart

Effect The heart extends shards of crystal imbued with force, like a jabbing blade, and deals (3d10+20) Force Damage damage and (3d10+20) Piercing Damage damage to all creatures in a 20-foot radius (Basic DC 40 Reflex Saving Throw save). A creature who takes piercing damage from the surge is exposed to crystal corruption. On a critical failure, a creature also takes 2d6 Persistent,bleed Damage damage.

generalAbilities.name: Crystalline Corruption
generalAbilities.description:
Creatures afflicted by this curse slowly turn to solid crystal. This affliction's sickened, slowed, and paralyzed conditions can't be removed until the affliction itself is removed. Creatures with both the earth and elemental traits instead become carriers and suffer no ill effects aside from gaining the weakness to sonic.

Saving Throw DC 40 Fortitude Saving Throw

Stage 1 sickened 1 (1 hour)

Stage 2 weakness 5 to sonic and Sickened 1 (1 day)

Stage 3 weakness 5 to sonic and Slowed 1 (1 day)

Stage 4 weakness 10 to sonic and Paralyzed (1 day)

Stage 5 weakness 10 to sonic, and the creature is permanently Petrified.
